MspDiagSystemInfo.Description: Collects OS, hardware, disk, and network details (including ipconfig /all and route print) to a text report.
InvokeScript:
$reportDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Desktop\MSP-Reports'
if (-not (Test-Path $reportDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $reportDir -Force | Out-Null }
$stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$out = Join-Path $reportDir "system-info-$stamp.txt"
$info = @()
$info += "=== MSP System Report ==="
$info += "Generated: $(Get-Date)"
$info += "Computer: $env:COMPUTERNAME"
$info += "User: $env:USERNAME"
$info += ""
$info += "--- OS ---"
Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object Caption, Version, BuildNumber, LastBootUpTime, TotalVisibleMemorySize, FreePhysicalMemory | Format-List | Out-String | ForEach-Object { $info += $_ }
$info += "--- CPU ---"
Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object Name, NumberOfCores, NumberOfLogicalProcessors | Format-List | Out-String | ForEach-Object { $info += $_ }
$info += "--- Disks ---"
Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter "DriveType=3" | Select-Object DeviceID, @{N='SizeGB';E={[math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,2)}}, @{N='FreeGB';E={[math]::Round($_.FreeSpace/1GB,2)}}, FileSystem | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | ForEach-Object { $info += $_ }
$info += "--- Network Adapters ---"
Get-NetAdapter | Where-Object Status -eq 'Up' | Select-Object Name, InterfaceDescription, LinkSpeed, MacAddress | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | ForEach-Object { $info += $_ }
$info += "--- ipconfig /all ---"
$info += (& "$env:SystemRoot\System32\ipconfig.exe" /all | Out-String)
$info += "--- route print ---"
$info += (& "$env:SystemRoot\System32\route.exe" print | Out-String)
$info | Out-File -FilePath $out -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "Report saved: $out"

MspDiagEventLog.Content: Export Critical Event Logs & Reliability Report
MspDiagEventLog.Description: Exports System/Application error and critical events (24h), saves a Reliability Monitor report (HTML + CSV, 30 days), and opens Reliability Monitor (perfmon /rel).

MspDiagNetwork.Description: Tests DNS resolution and ping to common endpoints (gateway, 8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1).

MspDiagDiskHealth.Description: Reports disk health status using Get-PhysicalDisk.
InvokeScript: Get-PhysicalDisk | Select-Object FriendlyName, MediaType, @{N='SizeGB';E={[math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,2)}}, HealthStatus, OperationalStatus | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host

MspDiagReportView.Description: Lists reports saved by other tools (MSP-Reports folder) and MSP Tool logs, and lets you select one to view or open.

MspMaintTempCleanup.Description: Removes user and system temp files older than 7 days, plus Delivery Optimization cache.

MspMaintDiskCleanup.Description: Launches cleanmgr for system drive (silent preset where supported).
InvokeScript:
Write-Host 'Running Disk Cleanup...'
cleanmgr /sagerun:1 2>$null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
  Write-Host 'Launching interactive Disk Cleanup...'
  cleanmgr /d C:
}
Write-Host 'Disk Cleanup initiated'

MspMaintOptimize.Description: Runs defrag/optimize on all fixed drives.

MspMaintWindowsUpdate.Description: Lists pending and recently installed updates.

MspSecDefenderScan.Description: Starts a quick malware scan with Microsoft Defender.
InvokeScript:
Write-Host 'Starting Defender quick scan...'
Start-MpScan -ScanType QuickScan
Write-Host 'Defender scan started (check Security Center for results)'

MspSecDefenderStatus.Description: Shows real-time protection, signature age, and last scan time.
InvokeScript: Get-MpComputerStatus | Select-Object AMServiceEnabled, AntivirusEnabled, RealTimeProtectionEnabled, AntivirusSignatureLastUpdated, QuickScanEndTime, FullScanEndTime | Format-List | Out-String | Write-Host

MspSecFirewall.Description: Reports firewall state for Domain, Private, and Public profiles.
InvokeScript: Get-NetFirewallProfile | Select-Object Name, Enabled, DefaultInboundAction, DefaultOutboundAction | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host

MspSecBitLocker.Description: Reports encryption status for all fixed drives.

MspSecLocalAdmins.Description: Lists local Administrators group members and can reset a selected local account password.

MspRepairSFC.Description: Scans and repairs protected system files. May take 15-30 minutes.
InvokeScript:
Write-Host 'Running sfc /scannow - this may take a while...'
sfc /scannow
Write-Host "SFC exit code: $LASTEXITCODE"

MspRepairDISM.Description: Repairs the Windows component store. Run before SFC if issues persist.
InvokeScript:
Write-Host 'Running DISM RestoreHealth - this may take a while...'
DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth
Write-Host "DISM exit code: $LASTEXITCODE"

MspRepairNetworkReset.Description: Resets Winsock and IP stack. Requires reboot.
InvokeScript:
Write-Host 'Resetting network stack...'
netsh winsock reset
netsh int ip reset
Write-Host 'Network stack reset. A reboot is recommended.'

MspRepairSearchIndex.Description: Restarts Windows Search and triggers index rebuild.
InvokeScript:
Stop-Service WSearch -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
Start-Service WSearch
Write-Host 'Search service restarted. Index will rebuild in background.'

MspSetupRestorePoint.Description: Creates a system restore point before making changes.
InvokeScript:
Checkpoint-Computer -Description 'MSP Tool - Pre-change snapshot' -RestorePointType MODIFY_SETTINGS
Write-Host 'Restore point created'

powercfg /setactive 381b4222-f694-41f0-9685-ff5bb260df2e
Write-Host 'Balanced power plan activated'

MspSetupTimeSync.Description: Restarts Windows Time service and forces NTP sync.
InvokeScript:
Stop-Service w32time -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Service w32time
w32tm /resync /force
Write-Host 'Time sync completed'

MspSetupRdpEnable.Description: Enables RDP and configures firewall rule for remote access.
InvokeScript:
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server' -Name fDenyTSConnections -Value 0
Enable-NetFirewallRule -DisplayGroup 'Remote Desktop'
Write-Host 'Remote Desktop enabled'

MspSetupHostname.Description: Displays hostname, domain/workgroup, and serial number.
InvokeScript:
$cs = Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem
$bios = Get-CimInstance Win32_BIOS
Write-Host "Hostname: $($cs.Name)"
Write-Host "Domain/Workgroup: $($cs.Domain)"
Write-Host "Manufacturer: $($cs.Manufacturer)"
Write-Host "Model: $($cs.Model)"
Write-Host "Serial: $($bios.SerialNumber)"

MspDomainStatus.Description: Shows if the workstation is domain joined, the domain name, and secure channel health.

MspDomainConnectivity.Description: Tests DNS resolution, DC discovery, and LDAP port 389 reachability for a domain.

MspVpnStart.Description: Lists VPN connections found on the workstation, starts the selected one, then offers to rerun domain connectivity.

MspDomainCredentialTest.Description: Verifies a supplied credential can authenticate to the target domain before joining a workstation.

MspVpnChecker.Description: Lists visible VPN connections, shows connection status, and prompts which one to start.

MspDomainGpUpdate.Description: Runs gpupdate /force and shows applied GPO results.

MspDomainJoin.Description: Prompts for domain FQDN and admin credentials, verifies connectivity, then joins the domain.

MspDomainUnjoin.Description: Unjoins the workstation from the domain and joins a workgroup.

MspDomainSecureRepair.Description: Tests and repairs the machine account trust with the domain (fixes 'trust relationship failed').

MspPerfSpecCheck.Description: Evaluates SSD/HDD, RAM, CPU, and workstation age against LENET Techno Stack V3.0 recommendations.

MspPerfResourceSnapshot.Description: Current CPU and memory usage. Consistently > 90% indicates a performance issue.
InvokeScript:
$os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem
$totalMem = $os.TotalVisibleMemorySize
$freeMem = $os.FreePhysicalMemory
$usedPct = [math]::Round((1 - ($freeMem / $totalMem)) * 100, 1)
Write-Host "Memory usage: ${usedPct}% ($([math]::Round($freeMem/1MB,0)) MB free of $([math]::Round($totalMem/1MB,0)) MB)"
if ($usedPct -gt 90) { Write-Host '[ISSUE] Memory consistently high - check top processes' }

$cpuSamples = @()
1..3 | ForEach-Object { $cpuSamples += (Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor).LoadPercentage; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
$avgCpu = [math]::Round(($cpuSamples | Measure-Object -Average).Average, 1)
Write-Host "CPU usage (3s avg): ${avgCpu}%"
if ($avgCpu -gt 90) { Write-Host '[ISSUE] CPU consistently high - check Resource Monitor' }
Write-Host 'Tip: Chrome with many tabs or high svchost often causes slowness. Patch/driver update may be needed.'

MspPerfOpenResourceMonitor.Description: Launches resmon.exe to inspect CPU, Memory, Disk, and Network per process.
InvokeScript:
Start-Process resmon.exe
Write-Host 'Resource Monitor opened. Check CPU/Memory/Disk tabs for processes > 90%.'

MspPerfTopProcesses.Description: Lists top resource-consuming processes. Helps identify Chrome, svchost, or other hogs.
InvokeScript:
Write-Host '--- Top 10 by CPU ---'
Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name, Id, @{N='CPU_s';E={[math]::Round($_.CPU,1)}}, @{N='MemMB';E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB,0)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host
Write-Host '--- Top 10 by Memory ---'
Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name, Id, @{N='MemMB';E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB,0)}}, @{N='CPU_s';E={[math]::Round($_.CPU,1)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host
Write-Host 'High svchost: try Windows Update or driver update. High Chrome: close unused tabs.'

MspPerfDismFull.Description: Runs dism scanhealth, checkhealth, and restorehealth. Screenshot each result.
InvokeScript:
$cmds = @('/scanhealth','/checkhealth','/restorehealth')
foreach ($arg in $cmds) {
  Write-Host "=== DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image $arg ==="
  $proc = Start-Process -FilePath DISM.exe -ArgumentList "/Online /Cleanup-Image $arg" -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow
  Write-Host "Exit code: $($proc.ExitCode)"
  Write-Host ''
}
Write-Host 'DISM sequence complete. Run SFC next.'

MspPerfManufacturerInfo.Description: Shows serial number and links to Dell/HP/Lenovo support and driver updater tools.

MspPerfStartupAudit.Description: Lists startup programs from registry and Startup folder. You can select one to remove from startup.

MspPerfServicesAudit.Description: Lists running non-Microsoft services. Review before disabling in msconfig.

MspPerfClearUserTemp.Description: Clears %temp% folder per LENET procedure. Skips locked files.

MspPerfDiskSpaceCheck.Description: Warns if any drive has less than 20% free (causes slow startup and performance).

MspPerfRecentUpdates.Description: Lists updates installed in the last 30 days. Select one to uninstall (via DISM), or reinstall an update this tool removed earlier (via Windows Update). Cross-check CWA Patching History.
